t: Google's Invisible Hand: Intelligence as a Utility
s: Google's deep vertical integration (data, hardware) enables it to price-dump 'Intelligence as a Service' (IaaS). The author leverages this to build 'Pipulate,' an 'actualizer layer' translating abstract thought into machine reality, realizing a 50-year futurist vision.
sub: Google's vertical integration for IaaS dominance (Books, YouTube, Chrome, TPUs)
Pipulate as the 'actualizer layer' blurring thought and machine action
Local-first build strategy leveraging Moore's Law for exponential future growth
